text:
anya: quick RFC follow-up: propose a tiny sidecar .fastopen.json for shards that gives format, shard_size, window_count, and either an index_hash or per-window MACs so clients can warm KV by streaming and verify later.

lee: good idea. keeps on-disk safetensors untouched. sidecar is optional and server can advertise via X-Weight-FastOpen header.

sam: tradeoffs: extra fetch for index vs trusting unverified warmup. suggest provisional entries in KV cache until verification.

jen: agree. we need a "provisional" flag on cache entries and a tombstone/unpin API for rollback on mismatch. runtime should reject provisional hits for production routes.

anya: security: sidecar should include a signed root_hash (sig-v1) so clients can check provenance without full manifest. index_hash points to signed index blob.

infra-bot: canary deploy scheduled: eng-ml/warmup-experiments @ 02:00 UTC.

lee: I'll draft minimal sidecar schema and a tiny test harness (curl + verify). keep defaults conservative: 1MB windows.

anya: will open short RFC and add canary. thanks all :thumbsup:
